def solve():
    # Inputs
    revenue = Q(4380000)                 # USD per year, unchanged
    cogs = revenue * Q(79) / 100         # cost of sales, USD per year
    days_year = Q(365)

    # Receivables: measured on revenue; days cut by 14
    ar_cut_days = Q(14)
    receivables_release = revenue * ar_cut_days / days_year  # base AR minus target AR (positive = cash released)

    # Inventory: measured on cost of sales; 82 -> 54 days
    inv_base = cogs * Q(82) / days_year
    inv_target = cogs * Q(54) / days_year
    inventory_release = inv_base - inv_target  # fall in inventory balance

    # Purchases: base year = COGS (flat inventory); program year = COGS + change in inventory
    base_purchases = cogs
    program_year_purchases = cogs + (inv_target - inv_base)

    # Payables: measured on purchases; 45 days (base) -> 65 days (target, on program-year purchases)
    ap_base = base_purchases * Q(45) / days_year
    ap_target = program_year_purchases * Q(65) / days_year
    payables_financing = ap_target - ap_base  # rise in payables balance

    # Net cash released
    net_release = receivables_release + inventory_release + payables_financing

    return {
        "final": net_release,
        "receivables_release": receivables_release,
        "inventory_release": inventory_release,
        "program_year_purchases": program_year_purchases,
        "payables_financing": payables_financing,
    }
